description: A full first year of integrated high-school math from the open (CC BY) Mathematics Vision Project: sequences, linear and exponential functions, features of functions, equations and inequalities, systems, transformations and symmetry, congruence and constructions, coordinate geometry, and data. Each day your student works one problem-solving task from the free student PDF, talks through the thinking with you, then does that task’s Ready, Set, Go! homework.
includes: 68 lessons in 9 modules (every task in the student edition)
Links to the exact page of each task and its Ready, Set, Go! homework in the free student PDFs
Link to the free teacher notes for each module
